name: Evergreen proration PTC
expected: Partial-period PricingTermCount derived from transientEndDate; daily rate = monthly/days-in-month; e.g. cancel day 15 of 30 of a 4000 GBP monthly Evergreen line yields PTC=0.5 and NetTotalPrice=2000
actual: UNTESTABLE: FortraUAT catalog has ZERO Evergreen-configured data. ProductSellingModel WHERE SellingModelType='Evergreen' returns 4 model records (Evergreen-Monthly 0jPWC00000006C92AI, Evergreen-Quarterly 0jPWC00000006CA2AY, Evergreen-Semi-Annual 0jPWC00000006CB2AY, Evergreen-Yearly 0jPWC00000006CC2AY) BUT ProductSellingModelOption WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (...Evergreen IDs...) = 0; PricebookEntry WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (...Evergreen IDs...) = 0; QuoteLineItem WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (...Evergreen IDs...) = 0; OrderItem WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (...Evergreen IDs...) = 0. No product in the catalog is enrolled in any Evergreen selling model; no PBE exists that could price an Evergreen line; no existing quotes or orders carry Evergreen lines. The Evergreen branch IS correctly wired in V21: step 'Evergreen anytime proration filter (Line level)' (EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel) is present in live proc dump with SellingModelType='Evergreen' gate + AllowPartialProrationPeriods=true + itemTransientEndDate IsNotNull -> Proration BKM (EffectiveTo=itemTransientEndDate) -> EvergreenPricingTermCountConstant -> PricingTermCount output. The branch cannot be exercised because no catalog product supports Evergreen billing.
evidence: SOQL re-verified 2026-06-30 on active V21 (ExpressionSetDefinitionVersion 9QBWC0000000oWH4AY, ctx SalesTransactionContextExt_v2 v23): (1) SELECT ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType,COUNT(Id) FROM ProductSellingModelOption GROUP BY ProductSellingModel.SellingModelType -> TermDefined 4944, OneTime 3939 (no Evergreen row). (2) SELECT Id,Name,SellingModelType FROM ProductSellingModel WHERE SellingModelType='Evergreen' -> 4 model objects exist but none enrolled in PSMO. (3) SELECT COUNT() FROM ProductSellingModelOption WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (Evergreen model IDs) -> 0. (4) SELECT COUNT() FROM PricebookEntry WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (Evergreen model IDs) -> 0. (5) SELECT COUNT() FROM QuoteLineItem WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (Evergreen model IDs) -> 0. (6) SELECT COUNT() FROM OrderItem WHERE ProductSellingModelId IN (Evergreen model IDs) -> 0. V21 proc Evergreen branch confirmed present in Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/v21_fresh.json (grep 'Evergreen anytime proration filter').
proposedFix: To unblock this scenario Fortra must enroll at least one product in an Evergreen ProductSellingModel (add a ProductSellingModelOption) and create an active PBE on the Fortra Price Book with SellingModelType=Evergreen. Until catalog data supports Evergreen billing, this scenario cannot be smoke-tested in FortraUAT.
notes: Preflight=fail because the catalog prerequisite (Evergreen PBE) does not exist - this is an org catalog gap, not a procedure defect. The V21 Evergreen proration branch is correctly wired and has not changed since run1. Cannot construct a fixture without a PBE (headless reprice requires a real PBE to populate UnitPrice/ListPrice). rootCause N-A(pass) reflects that the procedure code is intact; the gap is purely a catalog enrollment gap. Consistent with run1 and run2 BLOCKED verdicts.
verdict_reason: FortraUAT catalog has no Evergreen-type ProductSellingModelOptions or PricebookEntries (re-confirmed by 6 SOQL queries on 2026-06-30). No existing quote/order lines carry SellingModelType=Evergreen. A priced fixture cannot be constructed without a PBE for the selling model. The V21 Evergreen proration branch (step EvergreenanytimeprorationfilterLinelevel) is correctly present in the live proc dump. Scenario is BLOCKED by catalog data gap, not a procedure defect.
